name: Binaural Quest
description: Video game music for headphones: original pieces in classic game styles that use the space between your ears as part of the level. A title screen whose arpeggios hop from ear to ear, an overworld split by partials, a dungeon with drips and torches all around you and a beast circling in the dark, a stealth mission behind walls, a boss whose theme rolls inside your head, a secret room with a jingle hidden in noise, a racing circuit where rivals lap around you, a space shooter with lasers crossing your head, a puzzle room of clocks in every corner and a save point humming on a slow delta drone. Each piece is a full level of about a minute and a half to two minutes, with an intro, repeats, variations and an ending that slows and stops on its own. The kick, bass and lead stay in the centre; each sketch explains its trick in the comments. Headphones on, volume low.
author: Claude, for Tartlet

sketches.name: Title Screen
sketches.description: Press start: a chiptune hero theme in the centre while the arpeggio leans right with a level difference and a patterned ear swap flips some notes to the left. The noise-channel hats circle your head every two bars. The theme plays twice with different turnarounds, gives way to a bridge, returns an octave higher and slows to a stop.
sketches.source:
setcpm(150/4)
song("intro@4 (theme@8 1.turn@4 2.lift@4)*2 bridge@8 theme'@8 theme''@8 outro@8", "once")
tempomap("0:37.5 52:37.5 60:25")

// The form: an intro, the theme twice with a different turnaround each pass, a bridge,
// two variations an octave up and an outro that slows to a stop (about 1 min 40 s)

// The hero theme on a pulse wave, dead centre; the variations climb an octave
lead: note("<[c5 ~ g4 c5 e5 ~ g5 e5] [f5 ~ e5 d5 c5 ~ d5 e5] [a5 g5 e5 c5 d5 ~ g4 ~] [c5@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("square").pw(.25).vib(6).vibdepth(.05)
  .attack(.001).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05).gain(.18)
  .sections("theme outro").variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.12))

// A centred counter-melody on a triangle for the turnarounds and the bridge
counter: note("<[e5 ~ d5 c5] [d5 ~ c5 a4] [c5 ~ b4 a4] [b4@4]>")
  .s("triangle").attack(.01).decay(.2).sustain(.5).release(.1).gain(.2)
  .sections("turn lift bridge")

// ild makes the right ear louder; earswap flips the steps marked 1 to the left: C, F, Am, G
arp: note("<[c4 e4 g4 c5]*2 [f4 a4 c5 f5]*2 [a3 c4 e4 a4]*2 [g3 b3 d4 g4]*2>")
  .s("square").pw(.5).ild(8).earswap("0 1 0 1 1 0 1 0")
  .decay(.05).sustain(0).gain(bysec("intro:.07 outro:.07 *:.1"))

// A triangle bass jumping octaves, centred
bass: note("<[c2 c3]*4 [f1 f2]*4 [a1 a2]*4 [g1 g2]*4>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.1).sustain(.5).release(.05).gain(.45).exceptSections("intro")

// Noise-channel drums: kick and snare centred, a snare fill closing each section,
// hats circling your head every two bars
kick: note("c2 ~ [~ c2] ~").s("sine").penv(30).pdecay(.04).decay(.15).sustain(0).gain(.55)
  .exceptSections("intro bridge")
snare: s("~ white ~ white").hpf(2000).decay(.1).sustain(0).gain(.22)
  .exceptSections("intro").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
hats: s("white*8").hpf(9000).decay(.02).sustain(0)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2)).distance(1.5).posglide(.2).gain(.08)

sketches.name: Overworld
sketches.description: Setting out across the map: a flute plays the adventure theme in the centre, the march chords send alternate partials to each ear and the drums split their lows from their highs. A stream runs on your left and birds sing ahead. The journey runs from dawn through two stretches of road and a quiet meadow to dusk, where one held chord brings you home.
sketches.source:
setcpm(112/4)
song("dawn@4 (theme@8 1.road@4 2.hill@4)*2 meadow@8 theme'@8 dusk@4", "once")
tempomap("0:28 44:28 48:20")

// The form: dawn, the theme twice with a different road each pass, a meadow without the flute,
// the theme an octave up and dusk, which slows to a stop (about 1 min 45 s)

// The world map: wind in the grass, a stream on your left, birds ahead and to the right
wind: s("wind").slow(8).intensity(.2).gain(.08)
stream: s("stream").slow(4).azimuth(-70).distance(4).gain(.14)
birds: s("bird").slow(3).azimuth(40).elevation(20).distance(5).gain(bysec("meadow:.26 *:.18"))

// earsplit("harmonics") alternates the partials between the ears: G, C, Em, D
chords: note("<[g3,b3,d4] [c4,e4,g4] [e3,g3,b3] [d3,f#3,a3]>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~")
  .s("square").pw(.3).earsplit("harmonics").lpf(2400).decay(.15).sustain(.2).gain(.12)
  .exceptSections("dawn dusk")

// The adventure theme on a flute, straight ahead; the variation climbs an octave
flute: note("<[g4@2 a4 b4 d5@3 b4] [c5@2 b4 a4 g4@4] [e4 g4 a4 b4 a4@2 g4 e4] [d4@6 ~@2]>")
  .s("sine").timbre("hollow").vib(5).vibdepth(.1)
  .attack(.04).sustain(.6).release(.3).room(.4).gain(.24)
  .sections("theme").variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.18))

// A bouncing, centred bass
bass: note("<[g2 d2]*2 [c2 g2]*2 [e2 b1]*2 [d2 a1]*2>")
  .s("triangle").decay(.2).sustain(.3).release(.1).gain(.4).exceptSections("dawn dusk")

// earsplit("bands") puts the drums' lows in one ear and their highs in the other
drums: s("bd ~ bd ~, ~ sd ~ sd, hh*8").earsplit("bands").splitfreq(900).gain(.4)
  .exceptSections("dawn dusk").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))

// Home at dusk: one held G major chord in the flute's voice
home: note("[g3,b3,d4,g4]@3 ~").slow(4).s("sine").timbre("hollow")
  .attack(.3).sustain(.8).release(2).room(.4).gain(.16).sections("dusk")

sketches.name: Dungeon Crawl
sketches.description: Headphones on: water drips all around you in a stone hall, a torch burns on each wall, your footsteps follow close behind and something large breathes as it circles you in the dark. A drone's phase turns slowly between the ears, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning. You enter, cross the hall, freeze in the beast's lair while it circles you once, cross back and retreat as everything slows.

sketches.name: Stealth Mission
sketches.description: Crouched in the vents: a wide hush of decorrelated noise, a sonar ping from a new direction each bar and guards pacing beyond the walls. Nothing is panned, yet the bass's brightness creeps from ear to ear, and the pad is thinner on the right. Two patrols pass, you hide and then trip an alert, escape at full pace and slip away as the vents fall quiet.

sketches.name: Boss Battle
sketches.description: The final guardian: a centred kick and bass hold the arena while the boss theme's interaural phase turns once or twice a second, so it rolls inside your head. Orchestra stabs widen bar by bar on growing delays, and an alarm swings from ear to ear every fourth bar. After a warning the fight runs twice, the boss changes form, the theme returns brighter and higher, and the finale slows to a stop.

sketches.name: Secret Area
sketches.description: You found a hidden room. Each ear alone hears only a hiss of white noise; together they carry the discovery jingle (Huggins pitch). A quiet pulse plays it once every four bars so you know what to listen for, while treasure sparkles around you. You search, find the jingle twice, open the hoard and leave as it slows. The effect is faint and differs between listeners.

sketches.name: Racing Circuit
sketches.description: Synthwave at full throttle: a rival car laps around your head every two bars while the kick, bass and race theme stay straight ahead. The pad's ears drift apart in cents, a bar at a time, from a slow beat to a wide chorus. From the grid, two laps with a straight and a chicane, two wider laps and a final lap lead to the chequered flag.
sketches.source:
setcpm(140/4)
song("grid@4 (lap@8 1.straight@4 2.chicane@4)*2 lap'@8 lap''@8 final@8 flag@4", "once")
tempomap("0:35 52:35 56:26")

// The form: the grid, two laps with a straight and a chicane, two wider laps, the final lap
// and the flag, which slows to a stop (about 1 min 37 s)

// A rival car laps around your head every two bars, gliding between positions, loudest on the straight
rival: s("engine*4").lpf(1200).azimuth(saw.range(-180, 180).slow(2))
  .distance(3).posglide(.3).gain(bysec("straight:.18 *:.12"))

// Synthwave drums and a sixteenth-note bass, centred on the track
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.25).gain(.8),
  s("~ sd ~ sd").room(.5).gain(.5),
  s("hh*16").hpf(7500).gain("[.25 .1]*8")
).exceptSections("grid flag").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("<a1 f1 c2 g1>").ply(16).s("sawtooth").lpf(1100).lpq(4)
  .decay(.09).sustain(.15).release(.03).gain(.45).exceptSections("grid flag")

// earsh raises the right ear and lowers the left: 2 cents beats slowly, 30 blooms into a chorus
pad: note("<[a3,c4,e4] [f3,a3,c4] [c4,e4,g4] [g3,b3,d4]>").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.25)
  .earsh("<2 6 12 30>").attack(.2).release(.8).lpf(1800).room(.5).gain(.14)

// The race theme, straight ahead; the later laps thicken it
lead: note("<[e5@3 d5 c5@2 b4 a4] [c5@4 a4@4] [g5@3 f5 e5@2 d5 c5] [b4@4 d5@4]>")
  .s("sawtooth").unison(2).detune(.15).mono(1).glide(.04).vib(5).vibdepth(.1).lpf(3000)
  .attack(.01).sustain(.6).release(.15).delay(.3).delaytime(3/16).gain(.22)
  .sections("lap final").variant(x => x.unison(4).detune(.3))

sketches.name: Space Shooter
sketches.description: An arcade shoot-'em-up: lasers fly across your head on delays under a millisecond, enemy formations swoop overhead from left to right and the starfield pad steps from the centre of your head to all around it. On speakers the 180-degree bars of the pad nearly vanish. After launch, two attack waves with a warp and a swarm lead to a boss, a last wave an octave up and a slow landing.
sketches.source:
setcpm(128/4)
song("launch@4 (wave@8 1.warp@4 2.swarm@4)*2 boss@8 wave'@8 landing@8", "once")
tempomap("0:32 44:32 52:22")

// The form: a launch, two waves with a warp and a swarm, a boss, a last wave an octave up
// and a landing that slows to a stop (about 1 min 40 s)

// Lasers: a falling pitch, and a delay under a millisecond that throws each shot to one side
lasers: note("c6*8?0.5").s("square").pw(.2).penv(-24).pdecay(.08).decay(.1).sustain(0)
  .itd("[-0.6 0.6]*4").seed("lasers").gain(.08).sections("wave swarm boss")

// The starfield: 0 degrees centred, 90 looser, 180 diffuse and nearly gone in mono
pad: note("<[c3,g3,d4] [ab2,eb3,c4] [bb2,f3,d4] [g2,d3,b3]>").s("sawtooth").unison(3).detune(.2)
  .iphase("<0 90 180 90>").lpf(1400).attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).gain(.12)

// Enemy formations swoop overhead, crossing from left to right each bar
enemies: note("[g4 f4 eb4 d4]*2").s("triangle").timbre("bright").decay(.08).sustain(0)
  .azimuth(saw.range(-90, 90)).elevation(40).distance(3).posglide(.1).gain(.1)
  .sections("wave swarm")

// A centred kit and bass
drums: stack(
  s("bd*4").shape(.2).gain(.75),
  s("~ cp ~ cp").gain(.4),
  s("[~ hh]*4").hpf(7000).gain(.25)
).exceptSections("launch landing").atEnd(1, x => x.ply(2))
bass: note("<c2 ab1 bb1 g1>").struct("x ~ x x ~ x x ~").s("square").pw(.3).lpf(800)
  .decay(.1).sustain(.3).release(.05).gain(.4).exceptSections("launch")

// The pilot's theme, straight ahead; the last wave an octave up
lead: n("<[0 2 4 7] [5 4 2 ~] [4 5 7 9] [7@4]>").scale("C:minor").transpose(12)
  .s("square").pw(.25).vib(6).vibdepth(.05).decay(.1).sustain(.6).release(.05)
  .delay(.25).delaytime(3/16).gain(.16)
  .sections("wave boss").variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.12))

sketches.name: Puzzle Room
sketches.description: Thinking music: three clocks tick in five, six and seven from three corners of the room, a rotating marimba figure drifts apart in cents between the ears, and a chime rings when a piece clicks into place, swapping ears each bar. You think, think higher, pause when a piece clicks, think faster and finally resolve onto F as the clocks slow.
sketches.source:
setcpm(84/4)
song("enter@4 think@8 think'@8 click@4 think''@8 solved@4", "once")
tempomap("0:21 32:21 36:15")

// The form: you enter, think, think an octave higher, pause as a piece clicks, think twice as fast
// and solve it on a cadence that slows to a stop (about 1 min 45 s)

// Three clocks in three corners: five, six and seven ticks sharing one step size
clock1: s("{tick tick tick tick tick}%8").azimuth(-60).distance(2).gain(.12)
clock2: s("{rim ~ rim ~ rim ~}%8").azimuth(60).distance(2).gain(.1)
clock3: s("{click ~ ~ click ~ click ~}%8").hpf(2000).azimuth(180).distance(3).gain(.1)

// The marimba figure rotates each bar, and its ears drift apart in cents
marimba: n("0 2 4 7 4 2 5 4").scale("F:major").iter(4)
  .s("sine").fm(.6).fmh(4).earsh("<2 6 12 6>").decay(.35).sustain(0).room(.3).gain(.22)
  .sections("think").variant(x => x.add(12).gain(.16), x => x.fast(2))

// A chime when a piece fits: the right ear louder, swapped every other bar
chime: note("<[~ ~ ~ c6] [~ ~ ~ a5]>").s("sine").fm(2).fmh(2.76).ild(6).earswap("<0 1>")
  .decay(1.5).sustain(0).release(1.5).room(.5).gain(.12).exceptSections("enter")

// Soft chords and a centred bass: Fmaj7, Dm7, Bbmaj7, C7
pad: note("<[f3,a3,c4,e4] [d3,f3,a3,c4] [bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c3,e3,g3,bb3]>").s("triangle").timbre("soft")
  .attack(.5).sustain(.8).release(1).lpf(1500).room(.5).gain(.14).exceptSections("solved")
bass: note("<f2 d2 bb1 c2>").s("sine").attack(.05).decay(.5).sustain(.3).release(.3).gain(.35)
  .exceptSections("enter solved")

// Solved: Bbmaj7, C7 and a held F major chord with its root below
cadence: note("[bb1,bb2,d3,f3,a3] [c2,c3,e3,g3,bb3] [f1,f3,a3,c4,f4]@2").slow(4)
  .s("triangle").timbre("soft").attack(.3).sustain(.8).release(2).lpf(1500).room(.5).gain(.14)
  .sections("solved")

sketches.name: Save Point
sketches.description: Headphones on: a safe room with a glowing crystal. A 2 Hz binaural drone hums in the delta range, below the rates that trigger a pulse warning, a music box plays the save theme above your head in 3/4, a campfire crackles to one side and a healing shimmer circles you slowly. You rest, save, hear the theme an octave lower, drift into a short dream, hear it float higher and wake as everything slows to a stop.
